allowedSkipsMachineClasses.CcpClient.Tests.SurfaceTeardownTests.Aft: requires an INTERACTIVE Windows desktop (OverlayWindowProbe.MachineHasInteractiveDesktop): the fact asks the WINDOW MANAGER what it still holds after a process, or an application, has gone - whether a visible top-level window survives in the z-order, and whether the point where a surface used to be now routes to a REAL window belonging to somebody else. Os.RoutesAway* requires that non-zero owner DELIBERATELY, because an answer of 0 on a live desktop means the reading was taken off-screen rather than 'the desktop got its input back' - so off Windows it answers NO, and no keying exists that is not the INVERSE of the invariant. The remaining clauses are trivially true of a run that put no window on the screen. A property of the machine and the OS, never satisfiable by configuration. It does NOT skip on an ordinary interactive desktop, and its ELEVEN keyed siblings in the same classes still run everywhere - this list holds only the three for which keying was impossible.

skipSemantics: May-skip, not must-skip: a listed test that runs and passes on a machine where its precondition holds is green. Matching is exact on the pre-'(' portion of the TRX result testName (xunit theory rows serialize with arguments, e.g. Class.Method(x: 1)); a name with no parens matches whole. Anchor is the TRX result list, never Counters arithmetic.
admissionRule: allowedSkips is not a quarantine list. A test may be listed only when its precondition is a property of the machine or OS that cannot be satisfied by configuration during a contract run, and its change names the machine class where it executes. Two named PERMANENT BANS apply: (1) CcpClient.Tests.DataRootOverrideTests.DefaultSettingsPath_EnvUnset_IsThePlatformDefault must never be allowed to skip because a process-wide CCP_DATA_ROOT override makes the floor vacuous; (2) CcpClient.Tests.ChaosTunnelLoopbackTests.Logging_RouteClassesOnly_NeverFilenameOrQuery must be fixed at the source, never quarantined.
bumpRule: Bump total only in the same commit as the test change that moves the count, with the reason recorded here. Never widen, disable, or special-case a check to make a step pass. Adding a name to allowedSkips requires the admission rule above and the machine class where it executes.
lastMovedBy: +2 unit, +1 headless: THE LINUX LEG IS GREEN AGAIN ON BOTH PLATFORMS, and the 14 failures were TWO defect classes rather than one. CLASS A, THIRTEEN OF THEM, WAS A SINGLE ROOT CAUSE FIXED IN ONE LINE: every window identity in the real-desktop suite is an nint that is 0 where the mechanism does not exist, so 'routed == target' read '0 == 0' and answered YES. Those facts were ALREADY KEYED to the interactive-desktop property - the keying was simply DEFEATED BY THE COMPARISON, which is the subtlest form of the vacuity this port keeps catching. PointerWindowProbe.SameWindow now refuses two absences, applied at 20 comparison sites across 4 files. CLASS B, THE FOURTEENTH, called a P/Invoke DIRECTLY IN A KEYED FACT BODY, so off Windows it threw rather than read; it now routes through the short-circuit convention every probe in the suite already uses. ELEVEN ARE KEYED AND STILL RUN ON LINUX, asserting the honest refusal - the overlay capability returns Unavailable, no injection is accepted, no channel is delivered, no point routes to a window. THREE ARE GATED, and the reason is precise: Os.RoutesAway* requires a non-zero owner DELIBERATELY, because an answer of 0 on a live desktop means the reading was taken off-screen rather than 'the desktop got its input back', so keying them would mean asserting THE INVERSE OF THE INVARIANT as Linux's expected outcome. THE RECURRENCE GUARD IS HONEST ABOUT ITS OWN REACH: it bans a P/Invoke CALL in a fact body - reading bodies with comments and string literals blanked, because this suite NAMES USER32 entry points constantly in prose and a mention is not a call - and it self-checks SameWindow. IT CATCHES 1 OF THE 14, AND THE LANE MEASURED WHY NO CHEAP GUARD CATCHES THE OTHER 13: ten handle comparisons remain after the fix and FOUR ARE LEGITIMATE, because 'did this one reading move' is a different question that the non-zero clause would break - so a lexical ban would need an exemption ledger larger than the defect. It also considered and REJECTED a doc-versus-pin guard binding the recorded Linux total to floor.json, because it would red the suite after every land until someone re-ran Linux: a guard that cries wolf. THE DUPLICATE ACCESSIBLE NAME IS FIXED AND WINDOWS-RE-VERIFIED: the confirm button publishes 'Start Session (confirm)' while its VISIBLE CAPTION stays upstream's, because the caption is the ported outcome; the suffix is unconditional across all three states, since a name that changes shape between states is worse for a screen-reader user than one that does not. Five headed pairs re-verified green. AND THE EVIDENCE RECORD WAS NOT ALLOWED TO OVERCLAIM: the five AT-SPI rows still read GATED, because no Linux run has photographed them since, and a row moved to REACHED on a WINDOWS result is exactly the unmeasured claim that record exists to refuse. Both platforms: 0 failed. CcpClient.Tests 3481 to 3483, CcpClient.HeadlessTests 289 to 290.
